name: fly-setting
description: 现场复杂网络与视距通信智能规划工具

scripts.lint: pnpm -r --if-present run lint && uv run --project services/api --extra test ruff check services/api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck && uv run --project services/api --extra test mypy --config-file services/api/pyproject.toml services/api/src
scripts.build: pnpm -r --if-present run build && uv build --project services/api
